evaluation_label: pre-specified multi-parent headed-stud deployment family; not prospective or escrowed blind validation
central_estimand: measured ultimate shear resistance per headed stud in kN; reject any parent that cannot be converted from its original reported quantity using a pre-target physical rule

download_preflight.route: ordinary direct/normal desktop route; far below the 400 GB large-download threshold
download_preflight.resumability: HTTP Range where supported, otherwise restart only the incomplete archive
download_preflight.integrity: record byte size, SHA-256 and upstream checksum where supplied before extraction
download_preflight.release_boundary: third-party raw archives and extracted rows remain private local inputs; only adapters, registries, hashes and derived non-sensitive summaries may enter a public reproducibility repository

parents.object: headed stud connectors embedded in normal-weight solid concrete slabs
parents.sealed_target: reported measured ultimate shear resistance, harmonized only after the estimand/units audit

parents.object: headed studs welded in ribs of profiled steel decking transverse to beams
parents.sealed_target: reported measured ultimate shear resistance per stud in kN, if schema and test convention confirm equivalence

parents.object: headed stud connectors embedded in lightweight-concrete solid slabs
parents.sealed_target: reported measured ultimate shear resistance per stud in kN, if definition matches the development parent

parents.prespecified_external_subset: exclude every RCA=0 percent control; retain only RCA=20, 40 or 60 percent specimens, expected n=27
parents.object: headed studs in recycled-aggregate self-compacting concrete from one University of Basrah programme
parents.sealed_target: single-stud ultimate shear resistance in kN after row-to-paper verification

schema_only_access_before_target_unseal: workbook and sheet names, dimensions, merged-cell ranges and headers
declared units and formulas shown in headers or documentation
non-target geometry, material, topology, welding, arrangement and loading fields
non-target missingness, categorical support and row-level hashes
forbidden_before_target_unseal: reading, summarizing, plotting or modelling numerical target cells
choosing exclusions, unit conversions, features, provenance groups or claims based on target values
opening model predictions bundled with the RAC archive
tuning the compiler or learning models to these parents

overlap_audit.rule: quarantine the complete external source programme when it appears in the development parent; quarantine exact or probable duplicate specimens regardless of topology label

admission_gates.common_estimand: ultimate resistance per stud, kN, with a physically documented non-target-based conversion if needed
admission_gates.source_recovery: at least 95 percent of rows have a recoverable source/test-series identity
admission_gates.profiled_external_after_quarantine: at least 100 rows and 10 independent source groups
admission_gates.duplicate_tolerance: no unresolved duplicate or database-version inflation above 1 percent
admission_gates.RAC_gate: all retained rows map to the primary paper and have RCA above zero; report source-cluster limitation and never use n=27 alone for a broad claim
admission_gates.failure_action: refuse incompatible parent/contract compilation or downgrade the parent to descriptive schema evidence; never force harmonization

known_prior_work_boundary.claim_rule: do not claim first discovery of headed-stud material transfer; novelty is the typed deployment contract, source-overlap quarantine and auditable multi-parent validation/refusal
